_comment: Macro-level facts about Norwegian data centre power consumption, reserved grid capacity and projections. Cited from Nkom, NVE/Statnett, SSB, Stortinget Innst. 140S 2025-2026, Energiteknikk and the April 2026 Datasenter-Norge inventory. Used by the API /macro endpoint and rendered statically on the website.

consumption_trajectory_twh.basis: Trajectory projection plus known additions (AQ-OSL1B/1C, Bulk OS-IX doubling, Polar DRA1, Nscale Glomfjord ramp, Bulk N01 expansion, GM Hamar build-out)

installed_capacity_mw.comment: Sum of named operational sites in Table 2A plus an estimated 50-70 MW long-tail captive/crypto operators not separately disclosed. The 501 MW figure repeated in 2024 sources predates AQ Hønefoss B/C, Skygard, Polar DRA1, Bulk OS-IX doubling, Nscale Glomfjord and the 2025 Stack OSL04 expansions and is roughly 18 months stale by April 2026.

utilization_band.comment: Realised power draw as a fraction of nameplate MW. Used as a band when computing kommune share rather than the 100% upper bound.

regulatory_milestones.label: Datasenterforskrift under ny Ekomlov i kraft (Nkom-registrering for >0.5 MW)
